title: List Engineering Vehicle Components & Masses
description: SPARQL 1.1 SELECT query retrieving all mechanical and electrical vehicle components with their mass in kilograms sorted descending against a companion Turtle RDF dataset.

title: Satellite Thermal Margin & Over-Budget Filter
description: SPARQL 1.1 query using FILTER expressions to identify spacecraft avionics units whose peak dissipation exceeds their allocated radiator thermal budget.

title: UAV Subsystem Mass & Power BOM Rollup Aggregation
description: SPARQL 1.1 GROUP BY aggregation query computing total mass, total electrical power draw, and part counts per UAV subsystem against a companion bill-of-materials graph.

title: Transitive Dependency & Substation Failure Propagation
description: SPARQL 1.1 property-path query using transitive closure (+) to trace all downstream substation loads and protection bays affected by an upstream transformer outage.

title: Cross-Domain Requirement-to-Component Traceability Graph
description: Multi-file SPARQL 1.1 CONSTRUCT query synthesizing a verified requirement traceability matrix across separate requirements (.ttl) and system architecture (.owl) ontologies.
